propositions: Truncated bridge-echo duplicate comments exist on three Jira issues (REB-2605, REB-1931, REB-1567) that lack the reconciler marker due to truncation cutting off the marker after the body

These unmarked duplicates are identified by containing the reconciler's truncation suffix and lacking the reconciler marker, and must be cleaned by keeping only the oldest comment per distinct normalized body
Phase 2 cleanup executed 827 deletions across three issues with zero data loss, verified by pre-deletion backups and post-deletion re-fetch reconciliation
After bridge re-enablement, the keep-one rule must invert to preserve the comment id recorded by the bridge rather than the oldest, preventing re-creation of the original defect
The first bridge pass after re-enabling will re-post approximately one copy per distinct truncated comment due to empty comment_ids map, then dedupe from pass 2 onward
